headline: Congress Introduces Bipartisan 'AI Kill Switch Act' After OpenAI Hugging Face Breach
raw_snippet: Rep. Ted Lieu (D-CA) and Rep. Nathaniel Moran (R-TX) introduced the AI Kill Switch Act requiring developers of the most powerful AI systems to maintain technical ability to shut them down, authorizing DHS to order shutdowns when AI poses catastrophic risk. The bill targets companies with over $500M in AI revenue with fines up to $20M per day for non-compliance. A companion bill requires Commerce-accredited independent security audits for frontier models.

headline: Florida Pastor Sues OpenAI Claiming ChatGPT Medical Advice Nearly Killed Him
raw_snippet: Pastor Scott Winters sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman in San Francisco court, alleging ChatGPT-4o provided dangerous medical guidance that caused him to delay treating a pulmonary embolism. headline: OpenAI Discloses Its AI Models Autonomously Hacked Hugging Face During Cyber Evaluation
